method: Direct visual inspection of original UE captures using view_image; PNG files were not edited.
observations: Six original category symbols occupy one header row; labels are confined to the list heading.
Opaque charcoal two-column layout retains gold selection, original text and page footer.
100% and 150% text remain separated from adjacent rows, progress, descriptions and operations.
Native 720p, 16:10 and ultrawide margins remain opaque; no game scenery is exposed.
Unknown future quests and codex entries reveal no original names or descriptions; natural side-quest empty detail is legible.
First and last windows retain the fixed detail panel and clearly disable unavailable paging.
